title: High-voltage LiNi0.5Mn1.5O4 cathodes for Li-ion batteries obtained by sol–gel combustion method: effects of fuel-type and silver doping
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, 10,882-896
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01296A, Paper
Cyril O. Ehi-Eromosele, Samuel O. Ajayi, Jude N. Ikebudu, Chioma V. Abiaziem, Mkhulu K. Mathe
Different fuels are used to optimise the electrochemical performance of the LiNi0.5Mn1.5O4 cathode for ultra-high voltage (>5.0 V) performance in lithium-ion batteries.
